rule: Name the reader and the decision before any display is designed
source: Ivanković et al. 2021†; Jivet et al. 2018

rule: Show uncertainty as a numeric range, never as a vague hedge or a hidden point
Watch for the proxy moving without the goal; measure the goal where it can be measured
source: Jivet et al. 2018; Kaliisa et al. 2024†; Gerrish 2016†

rule: Build the common ground before the screen; test recognition with each community
tier: Adaptable in method; Fixed as sequence

rule: Where the measure is of a place, think multilevel: the place is information, not only an average
Never add a chart for its air of science; add it for the information it carries
Treat a league table as acting on the ranked; never present one as a reader's decision aid without intervals
source: Cochrane 2018; Marshall et al. 2000†; Espeland & Sauder 2007; Ch 1

rule: Recognition is checked before release, as a dialogue that can change the next release
Never let colour be the only means of distinguishing or conveying anything
Bar axes start at zero; a broken line axis is declared and the effect size it implies is chosen deliberately
source: Correll et al. 2020; Yang et al. 2021†; Long & Kay 2024

rule: Public defaults: linear scale, daily flow with the cumulative available, absolute risk with a fixed denominator and a stated interval
source: Romano et al. 2020†; Reinholtz et al. 2021; Akl et al. 2011; Pighin et al. 2011†

rule: Plan for a reader at PIAAC Level 1 and with low graph literacy; test with them
Name the denominator of every rate and make the alternatives reachable; use time-in-observation (person-time, venue-nights) where units are observed for unequal spans
Rates on small bases carry intervals and are shown in a funnel, never ranked raw or ranked adjusted
Show the effective importance of each part beside its nominal weight
source: Paruolo, Saisana & Saltelli 2013; Becker et al. 2017†

rule: Treat distance as a price only with the method's assumptions stated: single purpose, a declared value of time, substitutes considered
source: US EPA 2010; Fujiwara & Campbell 2011; Poor & Smith 2004†

rule: Report diversity as variety, balance and disparity, and declare which the index weights; count supplied and consumed diversity separately
Any early-warning indicator states its window, its threshold, and its out-of-sample record
Surveillance claims state their comparator and their boundary

No league table of places on any measure, and no bands of position (quintiles and the like); position is shown within a distribution with its interval, in categories of statistical separation from an expectation if categories are needed
kind: Evidence + Standard; the extension to every measure on a dashboard of small places is a Reading
source: Espeland & Sauder†; Goldstein & Spiegelhalter 1996; Marshall & Spiegelhalter 1998; Mogstad et al.†; EPR 2021; SHMI; RSS 2005†

rule: Compare places on a funnel or against a declared expectation, never by sorted value alone; where a display is sorted, the sort is a reading aid and the finding is position against limits
State and handle over-dispersion before reading points outside a funnel
Self-chosen comparators are shown beside the published set, labelled as chosen, and the choice is kept as data; they never define the comparison alone
source: Faulkender & Yang 2010†; Bizjak et al. 2011†; version 1 Ch 5

rule: Where each of two places exceeds the other on different measures, say they cannot be ordered
Before any change in a place selected for being extreme is read, regression to the mean is named as the first explanation
Words for likelihood carry their numbers in the sentence; no verbal likelihood term stands without one
source: Wintle et al. 2019; van der Bles et al. 2020†; IPCC 2010

rule: A fast or nowcast series is labelled an early sighting of the present, never a forecast
source: Choi & Varian; ONS Data Science Campus; Lazer et al.†

rule: The owner of the ticket is a role with a successor, and the record says where it lives
A measure says whether it is reflective or formative and is validated accordingly
Every felt measure states its recruitment route, response, known gaps and the share contributed by its most active contributors
Self-placement used as a measure is private before it is public, is one item among several, and its visible form is labelled a conversation, not a measure
source: Lorenz et al. 2011 †; Diamantopoulos et al. 2012; Schilling et al. 2002

rule: "What this changed" is a line on every felt measure: how many answered, what they said, how it informed the decision, within a stated time, told to the people who answered
source: Cabinet Office 2018; Sjoberg et al. 2017 †; Arnstein 1969

rule: A two-mode network states its boundary — which events and people are in it — because omitting contexts inflates clustering
Return is shown as return; stated intention to return is not a measure of it, and return alone is not attachment
A trace or signal is shown as an indicator of a vibe only after it has been validated against a descriptor in the place and population concerned; until then it is labelled an unvalidated indicator
source: De Nadai et al. 2016; Jaidka et al. 2020 (reconstructed); Brown & Coyne 2018; Orstad et al. 2017 †

rule: Experience sampling, where used, is within-person, its sample described, and its respondents' burden counted as a cost
source: MacKerron & Mourato 2013 †; Seresinhe et al. 2019; NRC 2013

rule: Recognition is gathered as member checking — who was shown what, what they said, what changed — and recorded as content and response-process evidence plus legitimacy; it is never presented as validation complete
source: Price et al. 2015; Birt et al. 2016 †; Chapter 5

rule: The harm assessment has three columns — persons, groups, places — and the place column asks about stigma, speculation, findability and the ecological fallacy for every panel
source: ICO DPIA; UKSA; Aaronson et al.; Glaeser et al. †

rule: Every written line links to the view that shows it, and every view to its line
Every interaction names its purchase from the table and its costs from the seven, or is cut; the static reading works before it is added
source: Mosca, Ottley & Chang 2021; Zikmund-Fisher et al. 2011 †; Lam 2008 †; Decision Book Ch 7

rule: The records' kinds sit on the face as statuses in text that open the record; a source line is followable, not only present
source: Burns et al.; Kennedy et al. 2016; Lin & Thornton †; Chapter 4

rule: A cell not shown is marked, explained by kind, and never blank; nothing is imputed into a withheld cell; a series is never joined across a gap; the maker expects, and does not design away, the lower confidence a shown gap produces against a dropped one
source: Sarma et al. 2022; Andreasson & Riveiro 2014 †; Analysis Function; Chapters 4, 10

rule: A choropleth shows rates, never counts; its breaks are declared and, "when possible", held constant across every view of the same measure; its legend is matched
A profile is small multiples of linear marks in a fixed, stated axis order, never a filled area; the form is held open to test
source: Albo et al. †; Feldman †; Waldner et al.; Javed et al. †

rule: Incomparable conditions are not added; the sentence says ahead-on-this, behind-on-that
Explanations are tested for decision quality, not liking
A dark register ships with a light one and the reader's choice is honoured
source: Piepenbrock 2013; Dobres 2017 †; While & Sarvghad 2024; AF colours; Chapter 13's floor

rule: Mood is carried only in channels that encode nothing
Never make the evidence layer harder to read on purpose
source: Xie et al. 2018; Weissgerber 2024 †; Hullman 2011 (the proposal)

rule: The strongest word is used sparingly: the Fixed register is short enough to be read and its requirements are enforced by the build; the long list is Adaptable and its departures are logged

A departure from a Fixed rule has a deviation entry written before it ships, in the same change, with a checker named before the entry is written who is not the author; the build fails on a departure without one
